# Anytime Dental Phoenix

> > A comprehensive family dental practice in Phoenix, AZ offering preventive care, cosmetic dentistry, implants, orthodontics, and emergency services with a team of experienced dentists.

Anytime Dental Phoenix is a full-service family dentistry practice serving the Phoenix, Arizona area with three experienced dentists (Dr. Ermis Mehretab, Dr. Zachary Coleman, and Dr. Andrew Kassman) and a dedicated support team. The practice emphasizes same-day appointments, emergency care, and accepts multiple insurance plans including Delta Dental, Cigna, and MetLife.

## Core Services

- [Comprehensive Dental Services](https://www.anytimedentalphx.com/services-2): Comprehensive dental services including implants, orthodontics, and cosmetic care
- [Dental Checkups & Cleanings](https://www.anytimedentalphx.com/services/dental-checkups): Preventive dental checkups, cleanings, and exams for all ages
- [Dental Implants](https://www.anytimedentalphx.com/services/dental-implants): Dental implants and smile restoration services in Phoenix
- [Orthodontics](https://www.anytimedentalphx.com/services/orthodontics): Orthodontics services and smile correction treatment options
- [Emergency Dentistry](https://www.anytimedentalphx.com/services/emergency-dentistry): Emergency dentistry with same-day appointments and free exams
